title: Chrome Azurol S Liquid Assay for Iron-Binding Compounds
author: Dr. Steven Wilhelm
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ifwcbpe

steps.title: Prepare CTAB solution
steps.instruction: Combine 6 mL of 10 mM CTAB (HDTMA) stock (BBI Biotech Catalog #CB0108‑100g) with 40 mL of Milli‑Q water and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Make Fe‑CAS mixture
steps.instruction: Mix 1.5 mL of FeCl₃‑HCl stock (1 mM FeCl₃ dissolved in 10 mM HCl, Iron(III) chloride hexahydrate, Sigma‑Aldrich Catalog #44944) with 7.5 mL of 2 mM CAS dye stock.

steps.title: Add Fe‑CAS to CTAB
steps.instruction: Slowly add the Fe‑CAS mixture to the CTAB solution while stirring continuously.

steps.title: Prepare piperazine acid solution
steps.instruction: First, add 6.5 mL of 12 N HCl slowly to 25 mL of Milli‑Q water; then add 4.3 g of anhydrous piperazine and mix gently.

steps.title: Combine piperazine solution
steps.instruction: Slowly mix the piperazine‑acid solution into the Fe‑CAS × CTAB mixture while stirring.

steps.title: Adjust final volume to 100 mL
steps.instruction: Bring the combined CAS solution to a final volume of 100 mL with Milli‑Q water.

steps.title: Add 5‑sulfosalicyclic acid
steps.instruction: Add enough 5‑sulfosalicyclic acid to achieve a final concentration of 4 mM in the 100 mL CAS solution.

steps.title: Dilute test sample
steps.instruction: Take the test sample and dilute it with Chelex‑100‑treated water to a final volume of 0.5 mL.

steps.title: Add CAS to sample
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL of the prepared CAS solution to the diluted test sample.

steps.title: Incubate assay
steps.instruction: Let the mixture sit for 1 hour at room temperature in the dark.

steps.title: Prepare controls and standards
steps.instruction: For the blank, use 0.5 mL Chelex‑100‑treated water; prepare a series of EDTA dilutions as a standard curve if desired.

steps.title: Measure absorbance
steps.instruction: Place each sample in a spectrophotometer and record absorbance at 630 nm (absorbance decreases with increasing siderophore).

steps.title: Calculate and report results
steps.instruction: Compute the ratio: absorbance of blank ÷ absorbance of sample. A ratio of 1.0 indicates no chelator; higher values indicate iron‑binding activity.
